text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Of course I'd lose. It's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I got a little overconfident even 
though I don't really have the skills.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nothing we could do about it this time. 
Yeah, that's right—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The Derby was super fun too! I gave it 
everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, everyone's expecting even bigger 
things from me! In that case, I've gotta 
surpass who I am right now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waah, I'm getting all fired up! I'm gonna 
get stronger than myself!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking maybe the distance was too 
long, or that it was just too early for 
me, stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
While I'm here overthinking things, she's 
just charging forward.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No wonder the spotlight chooses that 
girl.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Surely, from here on out too... always.
